summary: Recent updates in the Web Audio area focus on improving user experience during audio interruptions. When an audio interruption occurs, the browser will now **defer attempts to resume audio playback until it is appropriate to do so**, ensuring a smoother transition without abrupt stops. Additionally, the system now **waits for the AudioContext**—the underlying structure that manages audio— to fully start before trying to playback audio, which helps prevent issues such as audio lag or dropouts _during transitions_. These enhancements aim to create a more seamless listening experience for users navigating online audio content.
